A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Functional Adjoint Sampler study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A-C are readable and support comparison, including material reorganized in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original FAS experiments on Muller-Brown, alanine dipeptide, and chignolin, together with resolution tests and model-size and noise-scale ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Tables 1-3, Figures 1-6, and Appendix C.8.

M1.justification: The controlled diffusion, adjoint-matching loss, UNO control network, boundary lifting, and IDPP procedure are retained. The new main-text algorithms summarize existing procedures; the detailed sampling and training algorithms remain unchanged apart from numbering.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three systems and transition tasks, including the same finer-resolution sampling scenarios. Discussion of rectangular and graph domains remains prospective.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains MCMC and DL; Table 2 retains UMD, SMD, PIPS, TPS-DPS, and TR-LV. Citation updates, including TR-LV's year, do not introduce different evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The stated THP acceptance condition is corrected from X[L]-B < epsilon in v1 Appendix C.3 to ||X[L]-B|| < epsilon in v2 Section 5.1. This is a limited correction to the reported metric definition, without evidence of rerunning experiments. The 64-path averages, resolution settings, and Table 4 hyperparameters are unchanged.

E4.justification: The discretization tests and the noise-scale and UNO-size ablations are retained with the same questions and evidence. v1 Appendix C.6 becomes v2 Appendix C.8; reorganizing Figures 4-6 adds no analysis.

E5.justification: The existing plus/minus summaries and plotted variability are unchanged. v2 adds no seed counts, independent-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1-3 and Figures 1-6 retain the same results and trends. For example, FAS ETS remains -36.70 on Muller-Brown, -29.46 on alanine dipeptide, and -360.85 on chignolin, with unchanged reported uncertainties.

T1.justification: v2 revises foundational definitions, assumptions, and derivations: it distinguishes the Cameron-Martin space, corrects covariance formulas, rewrites the Girsanov/KL derivation, and removes the trace-class requirement on A in Assumption B.1. Lemma 1 changes its energy bound from U >= beta||x||^2 - C to U >= -beta||x||^2 + C and revises its proof, substantially broadening the claimed normalizability scope. The Proposition 6 proof and bridge formulas are moved, not newly added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims: extending adjoint sampling to Hilbert spaces, scalable matching-based training, and superior transition-path sampling with enforced endpoints.

C2.justification: The explanations of endpoint enforcement, molecular training stability, discretization behavior, and model scaling remain substantively unchanged. Both versions acknowledge the focus on one-dimensional domains and defer broader applications; the new impact statement adds no specific scientific limitation.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-repository link in the abstract, and its new Algorithm 2 explicitly documents zero-control initialization. Architecture, replay-buffer settings, force fields, clipping, and other detailed implementation information were already present in v1.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Guo et al., Zhu et al., Raja et al., and the Franzese-Michiardi survey, removes the Brehier citation, and expands Section 4 with a TPS positioning paragraph. The principal novelty positioning remains unchanged; other reference updates largely concern the same works' publication metadata.

P1.justification: v2 expands Section 3.4's numerical explanation, moves metric definitions into Section 5.1, subdivides Appendix C's numerical material, and gives the Proposition 6 proof its own subsection. Local language edits, an impact statement, and publication and funding text accompany this limited reorganization.

P2.justification: v2 adds two main-text algorithm boxes summarizing existing procedures, adjusts caption styling and Figure 2's explanation, and relocates appendix displays. The six scientific figures and four tables retain their underlying content.

improvement.justification: v2 improves exposition and code-access information and corrects covariance formulas and the inconsistent trace-class assumption on A. However, v1's positive quadratic energy bound guaranteed integrability, whereas v2's broadened Lemma 1 needs a restriction linking beta to the Gaussian covariance that its statement does not supply; Appendix B.3 assumes the required exponential integrability. These benefits coexist with a new gap in a foundational guarantee, while empirical evidence is unchanged, leaving the net quality direction uncertain.
